title: Architectural Construction Documentation Specialist
description:

• Proficiency in Revit Architecture.
• Proficiency in AutoCAD.
• A sound understanding of BIM workflows and building information management principles.
• Ability to create, modify, and manage parametric Revit families.
• Thorough knowledge of architectural construction documentation standards and principles.

• Comprehensive knowledge of building materials, their properties, and installation methods.
• Familiarity with national building codes and regulations.
• Ability to perform quality checks on models, drawings, and construction deliverables.
• Ability to interpret structural and MEP drawings.
• Ability to resolve construction-related issues and propose practical, buildable solutions.

• A strong work ethic and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
• Detail-oriented, with a strong focus on drawing quality and accuracy.
• Ability to work collaboratively and communicate effectively with designers and construction teams.
• Strong time-management skills and the ability to deliver documentation on schedule.

title: Chief Operating Officer(COO)
description:
استخدام مدیر اجرایی و عملیاتی (Chief Operating Office-COO)
یک شرکت معتبر فنی و مهندسی فعال در حوزه‌های نفت و گاز، پتروشیمی، پالایشگاه، فولاد و نیروگاه، در راستای توسعه فعالیت‌ها و ارتقای بهره‌وری سازمانی، از افراد متخصص و باتجربه برای تصدی موقعیت شغلی مدیر اجرایی و عملیاتی (COO) دعوت به همکاری می‌نماید.
شرح وظایف و مسئولیت‌ها:
- برنامه‌ریزی، سازمان‌دهی و راهبری عملیات اجرایی شرکت در راستای تحقق اهداف و برنامه‌های تعیین‌شده توسط مدیریت ارشد
- مدیریت و نظارت بر اجرای هم‌زمان پروژه‌ها، کنترل پیشرفت فعالیت‌ها و اطمینان از تحقق اهداف زمانی، مالی و کیفی
- ایجاد هماهنگی مؤثر میان واحدهای فنی و مهندسی، تولید، تأمین، مالی و اداری با هدف تسهیل فرآیندهای اجرایی
- مدیریت و تخصیص بهینه منابع انسانی، تجهیزات و بودجه عملیاتی با هدف افزایش بهره‌وری و کاهش هزینه‌ها
- شناسایی گلوگاه‌های عملیاتی، ارزیابی ریسک‌ها، مدیریت بحران و تدوین و پیگیری اقدامات اصلاحی
- طراحی، مستندسازی، استانداردسازی و بهبود مستمر فرآیندها و رویه‌های سازمانی
- تدوین و پایش شاخص‌های کلیدی عملکرد (KPI)، تحلیل عملکرد واحدها و ارزیابی میزان تحقق اهداف
- تهیه گزارش‌های تحلیلی و داشبوردهای مدیریتی و ارائه گزارش‌های دوره‌ای به مدیرعامل
- هدایت جلسات عملیاتی، نظارت بر اجرای مصوبات و پیگیری تعهدات واحدهای مختلف
- رهبری و توانمندسازی مدیران میانی، مدیریت تعارضات سازمانی و توسعه فرهنگ پاسخ‌گویی و نتیجه‌گرایی
شرایط احراز:
- حداقل مدرک کارشناسی در رشته‌های مهندسی صنایع، مدیریت صنعتی، مدیریت پروژه یا مدیریت کسب‌وکار؛ مدرک MBA مزیت محسوب می‌شود.
- حداقل 10 سال سابقه کاری مرتبط در حوزه مدیریت اجرایی، عملیات یا پروژه
- سابقه فعالیت در شرکت‌های مهندسی، صنعتی، پیمانکاری یا پروژه‌محور؛ تجربه فعالیت در شرکت‌های متوسط و چابک در اولویت است.
- توانایی مدیریت هم‌زمان پروژه‌ها، کنترل منابع و تصمیم‌گیری مبتنی بر داده
- مهارت بالا در رهبری تیم‌های چندوظیفه‌ای، مدیریت تعارض، مذاکره و حل مسئله
- تسلط بر طراحی شاخص‌های عملکرد، تهیه گزارش‌های مدیریتی و بهینه‌سازی فرآیندهای سازمانی
- آشنایی مناسب با زبان انگلیسی در مکاتبات، گزارش‌های مدیریتی و اصطلاحات تخصصی پروژه

title: Product Manager
description:
Description of duties:
Determining short-term and long-term goals of the brand in accordance with the company's strategy
Providing forecast, market analysis and documentation of new product pricing proposals
Designing and implementing comprehensive marketing plans to strengthen brand position, ensure product competitiveness and increase market share
Analyzing the market, competitors and consumer behavior for brand improvement and innovation
Managing advertising campaigns in different channels
Supervising content production and maintaining the integrity of the visual identity
Compilation and management of brand budget and cost optimization
Planning, ordering and supervising the design and production of all promotional materials
Coordination with the development, design, supply, sales, etc. teams to ensure the correct implementation of programs
Qualifying conditions:
The ability to think strategically, analytically and have a comprehensive view of the drug industry market
Full familiarity with branding and marketing processes
Time management skills and organizing and managing projects
Skills in follow-up, negotiation, and effective interdepartmental communication

Commitment, responsibility, result orientation, teamwork spirit and leadership ability
* Familiarity with the principles of graphic design and printing, an MBA Marketing degree is considered an advantage*

title: B2B Sales Specialist
description:
بوتیک شیرینی لامور برای توسعه بازار و گسترش حوزه فروش خود، از یک کارشناس فروش خوش‌برخورد، خلاق، منظم و توانمند در برقراری ارتباطات تجاری دعوت به همکاری می‌کند.
به دنبال فردی هستیم که با مذاکره و پرزنت حرفه‌ای، شناسایی فرصت‌های جدید و ارائه ایده‌های خلاقانه، به رشد فروش و توسعه شبکه مشتریان لامور کمک کند.
شرح وظایف
• شناسایی و جذب مشتریان سازمانی و تجاری، از جمله کافه‌ها، رستوران‌ها، شرکت‌ها و ...
• طراحی پیشنهادهای فروش خلاقانه برای مناسبت‌ها و همکاری‌های بلندمدت
• برقراری ارتباط مؤثر با مشتریان و معرفی حرفه‌ای محصولات
• پیگیری مذاکرات تا نهایی‌شدن سفارش و توسعه روابط تجاری
• صدور دقیق فاکتور و کنترل تطابق سفارش‌ها با محصولات خروجی
• ارائه ایده‌های جدید برای توسعه بازار و افزایش فروش
شرایط احراز
• روابط عمومی قوی و توانایی مذاکره با مدیران و تصمیم‌گیرندگان
• فن بیان مناسب، قدرت پرزنت و ظاهر آراسته
• خلاقیت و توانایی شناسایی فرصت‌های جدید فروش
• دقت، نظم و مسئولیت‌پذیری بالا
• سابقه فروش سازمانی (B2B) یا توسعه بازار، مزیت محسوب می‌شود.
در لامور، به دنبال همکاری هستیم که با رویکردی خلاقانه، ارتباطات حرفه‌ای و برنامه‌ریزی هدفمند، فرصت‌های جدیدی برای رشد و توسعه فروش ایجاد کند.

title: Sales Expert
description:
Job Title: Retail Sales Associate
Job Description & Responsibilities
* Greet customers warmly and assist them in selecting and purchasing products.
* Present products, explain their features and benefits, and provide accurate information to customers.
* Respond professionally and courteously to customer inquiries and follow up on their requests.
* Process sales transactions, issue accurate invoices, and handle payments.
* Arrange, organize, display, and price products on shelves.
* Monitor inventory levels and report stock shortages to the relevant supervisor.
* Maintain cleanliness, organization, and a professional appearance throughout the store.
* Check product expiration dates and conditions when applicable.
* Collaborate with team members to improve sales performance and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Comply with store policies, procedures, and customer service standards.
Qualifications & Requirements
* Friendly, professional attitude with strong interpersonal skills and a sense of responsibility.
* Attention to detail, organizational skills, and punctuality.
* Excellent communication and customer service skills.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
* Previous experience in retail sales is considered an advantage.

title: Senior Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
We are expanding our presence in financial markets and fintech, and we're looking for a creative, versatile and results-driven Senior Digital Marketing Specialist to play a key role across marketing, from content creation and distribution to campaign execution and data analysis. If you have a 360° view of marketing, speak the language of financial markets, and want to make a direct impact in a dynamic, data-driven environment, we'd love to hear from you.
Responsibilities
• Plan and run acquisition, activation and re-engagement campaigns against numeric targets (qualified sign-ups, acquisition cost)
• Own the budget for your channels and shift spend toward the best-performing ones
• Design and run A/B tests on landing pages, offers and messaging
• Build automated email and SMS flows, from sign-up to first deposit and win-back of inactive users
• Report monthly on KPIs and turn them into decisions: continue, adjust, scale up or stop
• Work with the Sales, Product and Design teams on consistent messaging and a seamless user journey
• Use AI tools every day to speed up research, content and analysis
Requirements
• 5+ years of digital marketing experience with measurable results you can share
• Hands-on experience with Google Analytics, Search Console and analytics dashboards
• Comfortable working with a range of AI tools
Nice to have
• Experience in fintech (we provide the training you need)
• Good English
Benefits
• USD performance bonus
• Thursdays off, 3 hours of flexible time
• Training and personal development budget, plus AI tool subscriptions
• Corporate food allowance (SnappFood) and wellness allowance (therapy and sports)
Terms
Full-time, on-site, Aghdasieh, Tehran. Saturday to Wednesday, 8:00–17:00.

Nice To Have

title: Senior R&D Manager
description:
HR Bamboos connects exceptional professionals with reputable organizations across Iran and international markets.
We are seeking a Senior R&D Manager on behalf of an established pharmaceutical company. The role focuses on leading new product development, optimizing existing formulations, and transferring products from development to commercial-scale manufacturing. We are looking for a strategic, results-oriented leader with strong change management skills to drive the company's R&D initiatives
Key Responsibilities
•Develop R&D strategies and execution plans aligned with the company's objectives and product portfolio priorities.
•Contribute to new product selection by evaluating technical feasibility, resource requirements, and development costs.
•Lead the design and development of new product formulations and the revision of existing formulations and manufacturing processes.
•Oversee product development from laboratory and pilot-scale batches through scale-up and technology transfer to manufacturing lines.
•Lead the preparation and review of R&D documentation and relevant sections of the Common Technical Document (CTD) for submission to the Regulatory Affairs team.
•Direct the investigation of manufacturing issues and develop corrective solutions for formulation and manufacturing process challenges.
•Plan and manage budgets, equipment, and raw materials required for R&D projects.
•Lead and develop the R&D team by setting objectives, evaluating performance, and transferring technical knowledge to team members.
What You Bring
•Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.)
•At least 10 years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry, including experience managing R&D teams and projects.
•Strong expertise in pharmaceutical dosage form formulation, product development, and drug manufacturing processes.
•Hands-on experience in scale-up, technology transfer, and troubleshooting manufacturing issues.
•Strong knowledge of bioequivalence studies and the Biopharmaceutics Classification System (BCS).
•Expertise in preparing and reviewing CTD documentation and understanding regulatory requirements related to pharmaceutical product development and registration.
•Strong knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), pharmacopeial standards, and quality management system requirements.
•Practical knowledge of ICH guidelines for pharmaceutical development and quality risk management.
•Experience assessing and managing quality risks using approaches such as Quality Risk Management (QRM) and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA).
•Strong project management and prioritization skills, including managing multiple projects, allocating resources, and making decisions based on scientific and technical data.
•Proven leadership and team development skills, with experience coordinating effectively across different organizational functions.
Nice to have
•Experience developing novel drug delivery systems.
•Experience applying Quality by Design (QbD) principles to product development and manufacturing processes.
•Previous research collaboration with universities and research institutions on drug development projects.
If you’re looking for a dynamic environment where your ideas, perspective, and contributions can make a meaningful impact on both your professional growth and the organization’s success, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Angular Developer
description:
HR Bamboos connects exceptional professionals with reputable organizations across Iran and international markets.
We are seeking an experienced Senior Angular Developer to join our client, a leading HealthTech company, and play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance, scalable, and user-centric web applications.
This role is ideal for a senior frontend professional with strong expertise in Angular, TypeScript, and modern frontend architectures, who is passionate about building reliable digital solutions that improve healthcare experiences.
Key Responsibilities
Frontend Development & Architecture
• Develop and maintain production-grade applications using Angular (v14+).
• Build scalable, modular, and reusable components and design systems.
• Integrate complex RESTful APIs and optimize application performance.
Quality & Engineering
• Write clean, modular, and testable code.
• Implement unit and end-to-end testing using Jasmine/Jest and Cypress/Playwright.
• Manage codebases with Git and conduct code reviews.
• Ensure accessibility, security, and cross-browser compatibility.
Collaboration
• Work closely with Product, Design, Backend, and QA teams throughout the SDLC.
• Troubleshoot complex frontend issues and drive continuous improvement.
• Mentor junior developers and contribute to technical knowledge sharing.
What You Bring
• 6+ years of frontend development experience, with strong Angular expertise.
• Expert knowledge of TypeScript, RxJS, and NgRx or similar.
• Strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility, and frontend performance.
• Experience with Git, automated testing, and modern web architectures.
• Proven experience in architecting high-performance Angular applications.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent command of English.
• Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or AWS is a plus.
What We Offer
• The opportunity to work on large-scale systems used globally.
• Collaboration with experienced engineers and product leaders.
• Relocation support to Armenia.
If you’re looking for a dynamic environment where your ideas, perspective, and contribution can make a meaningful impact on both your growth and the organization’s success, we’d love to hear from you.
Apply now
We maintain the highest level of confidentiality throughout the recruitment process.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
About Tiva Digital
Tiva Digital is a full-service digital marketing agency helping Australian small businesses grow through paid advertising, SEO, web development and creative. We manage a diverse portfolio of clients across professional services, e-commerce, healthcare and trades. Our team combines developers, designers, SEO specialists and marketers to deliver measurable results.
The Role
We're looking for a hands-on Senior Performance & Growth Specialist to plan, launch and optimise paid advertising campaigns across Google and Meta for our clients. You'll own campaign performance end-to-end — from strategy and setup through to reporting and continuous optimisation — while collaborating with our wider team to bring campaigns to life.
Key Responsibilities
• Set up, manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns (Search, Performance Max, Shopping) and Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)
• Plan and execute promotions, seasonal campaigns and lead-generation initiatives across multiple client accounts
• Monitor performance daily and optimise campaigns for conversions, cost-per-acquisition, ROAS and budget efficiency
• Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, A/B testing of ad copy and creative, and ongoing bid management
• Track and report on campaign performance using GA4, Google Ads and Meta reporting, translating data into actionable insights for clients
• Collaborate with developers, graphic designers and SEO specialists to align landing pages, creative and organic strategy with paid campaigns
• Stay current with platform updates, ad policies and industry best practice
About You (Essential)
• Proven hands-on experience managing Google Ads and preferably Meta Ads campaigns (agency or in-house)
• Strong understanding of campaign strategy, conversion tracking and performance optimisation
• Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking setup
• Knowledge of landing-page optimisation and CRO principles
• Analytical mindset — comfortable working with data, metrics and reporting tools
• Able to manage multiple client accounts and priorities at once
• A collaborative team player who works well alongside developers, designers and SEO specialists
• Fluent written and spoken English
• Excellent attention to detail and a results-driven approach
• Self-motivated and disciplined working remotely with flexible hours
Nice to Have
• Google Ads and/or Meta certifications
• Degree in Digital Marketing or related fields
What We Offer
• Competitive salary (Includes Performance bonus and can be adjusted based on experience and skills)
• Work from home with flexible hours
• Work across a varied portfolio of clients and industries
• A supportive, multidisciplinary team environment
